title: SWF package test fixtures build frames manually — missing motionEaseType/motionSnap/shapeEaseType causing 102 TypeScript errors
description:
The Frame type in @flash/core was updated to make motionEaseType, motionSnap, and shapeEaseType required fields (non-optional). However, the 105 test files in packages/swf/src/__tests__/ and visual-fixture.ts build Frame objects as raw object literals without using createFrame(), so they all miss these required fields.

Running 'cd packages/swf && npx tsc --noEmit' reports 102 TypeScript errors like:
  'Type { ... } is missing the following properties from type Frame: motionEaseType, motionSnap, shapeEaseType'

These are silently ignored at test time because vitest does not type-check, so all 105 test files pass. But the TypeScript errors mean the build is technically broken and any CI step that runs tsc will fail.

Some test fixtures also use a createFrame helper (buttonactions.test.ts etc) that returns Frame objects with motionEaseType typed as 'TweenEaseType | undefined', causing TS2322 errors where TweenEaseType is required.

Fix options:
1. Update all test fixtures to use createFrame() from @flash/core instead of raw object literals — preferred since createFrame() defaults all the new fields correctly.
2. Make motionEaseType, motionSnap, shapeEaseType optional in the Frame type (but this would weaken the model).
3. Add a makeFrame() test helper to packages/swf/src/__tests__/ that wraps createFrame() for backward compatibility.

Option 1 is cleanest. The test fixtures are in packages/swf/src/__tests__/ (105 files) and packages/swf/src/__tests__/visual-fixture.ts.
